headline: Going Commando's USA v1.01 progress report rises from 94.26% to 96.18% of code matched
summary: The project's last progress report puts Going Commando's USA v1.01 at 96.18% of code matched, up from 94.26% the previous day, with 8,420 of 8,527 functions. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. New compiler options turn previously near-matching C into exact matches, including HUD setup, Maktar Nebula code and the anti-aliased frame-buffer setup. Matching work also carries across to PAL and USA v2.00.
highlights: The last progress update puts PAL at 95.41% of code and 8,476 of 8,607 functions. USA v2.00 is at 95.68% of code and 8,452 of 8,579 functions.
Further matches landed after that refresh, including work in Oozla, Tabora, Hrugis Cloud, Gorn and Grelbin, followed by batches of seven and five USA v1.01 functions.
The release catalogue removes leftover entries and corrects function boundaries, changing the PAL and USA v2.00 totals as well as adding matches.

#434 proposes documentation for a USA v1.01 near miss and adds no match. #435 proposes upstreaming OpenRAC's local changes, including a sound-slot limit fix, without changing progress reports. Neither merged.
